deployments_detail.use: no confirmed AI deployment found (power-sector financing NBFC; workflow/document digitalisation only, no named AI/ML system)

As RDSS nodal agency, PFC uses Artificial Intelligence to analyze data generated by IT/OT devices (system meters, prepaid smart meters) to auto-generate monthly energy-accounting reports enabling DISCOMs to act on loss reduction, demand forecasting and Time-of-Day tariffs. [none named (indigenous, under RDSS)]
GeoAI-based asset mapping for power distribution utilities, showcased by PFC as part of its digital/IT-OT technology stack to modernise distribution networks. [none named]
AI-driven real-time fault detection systems for the distribution grid, demonstrated by PFC at Bharat Electricity Summit 2026 to improve reliability and last-mile connectivity. [none named]

Indigenous SCADA-ADMS-OMS grid-management platform incorporating AI/ML applications for operational efficiency and predictive maintenance in power distribution, promoted by PFC/REC. [none named (indigenous/Make-in-India)]
National Data Analytics and Reporting Centre (NaDAR), a PFC/RDSS-backed facility at NPTI Faridabad focused on high-level data analysis and reporting for the energy sector. [none named (with NPTI)]

National SCADA Resource Centre (NSRC), a Centre of Excellence set up under RDSS with PFC as nodal agency for research, implementation and standardization of SCADA supervisory-control/data-acquisition systems automating power distribution. [none named (at NPTI Faridabad)]
Integrated web portal for government power schemes (including RDSS) built by PFC as a 'single version of truth' consolidating scheme data and vital analytical reports published by PFC. [none named]
